description: The Sonny Ramadhin Statue at Palmiste Park is significant as a memorial to one of Trinidad and Tobago's most important cricketing figure and to the development of West Indies Cricket. He played a pivotal role alongside Jamaica's Alf Valentine, in the West Indies 'historic victory over England at Lord's 1950. The team's first test victory in England. Ramadhin took 11 wickets in the match. (Source: National Trust of Trinidad and Tobago) Check current opening arrangements, visitor access and any fees before travelling.
